crossFlowRegression: backward edge → flow:<target>: ticket regresses to stage "<stage>"
exhaustionReason: loop exhausted at <stepId> (<counter> = <count>, limit <limit>); choose: advance (accept as is), retry (exactly one more <target>), abort
rollback: <branch>: rolled back to <shortStartSha> — a run that did not complete leaves the ticket branch as it found it

unpricedSuffix.one: (+1 unpriced step — vendor reports no price)
unpricedSuffix.many: (+<count> unpriced steps — vendor reports no price)

log.retryGrant: run=<runId> gate=retry counter=<counter> set=<limit> (one further traversal authorised)
